title: Sazabi Launches Version 1.0 of AI Monitoring Tool for Software Teams
summary:
Autonomous cloud agents now scan system logs to find and investigate software anomalies before end users can report them. Sazabi's newly released platform provides developers with a filtering system that removes alert noise to deliver actionable notifications about critical failures in an application.

The software was developed over the past year to support development teams in an AI era where agents merge their own pull requests and junior developers operate with up to 100x leverage. Version 1.0 of the tool includes self-serve access, log search functions, and live dashboards to manage codebases that undergo hundreds of deployments per day.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Agents merging their own PRs. Hundreds of deployments per day.
selectedTweets.text:
Today, we're launching Sazabi version 1.0.

The reality of shipping software as a team in the age of AI is actually crazy.

Agents merging their own PRs. Hundreds of deployments per day. A codebase that is constantly changing. Junior developers with 10x or 100x leverage. 😵‍💫

I spent the last year building a safety harness for teams that ship with AI. It's called @sazabi.

The premise is simple:
1. You send us logs. 
2. We detect anomalies, investigate them, and send you back rich, actionable alerts about real problems in your app.

Sazabi helps you find issues before your users notice. 

No monitors or noisy alerts. Just pure signal. 

And today we're making it available for anyone to use.
